name: Weighted Single-Source Shortest Paths
problem_statement: Compute minimum path-weight sums from one source to every vertex in a graph with nonnegative edge weights.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

required_outputs.name: distances
required_outputs.description: Minimum path weights; null denotes unreachable within the cutoff.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: Whether all requested distances were computed.

solution_semantics.objective: Minimize path-weight sum from the source.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact distances up to declared floating-point tolerance; negative weights are outside this contract.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Compare distances with Dijkstra on small fixtures.
Every reachable nonsource predecessor satisfies the path-distance recurrence.
All weights are nonnegative and finite.
edge_cases: Zero-weight edges and cycles are valid.
An isolated source has distance zero.

correctness: Compare distances with Dijkstra on small fixtures.
Every reachable nonsource predecessor satisfies the path-distance recurrence.
All weights are nonnegative and finite.
